title.fil: Panimulang talakayan at paliwanag sa UHC

purpose.en: Explain UHC without promising unverified services.
purpose.fil: Ipaliwanag ang UHC nang walang pangakong hindi natiyak.

group_size.en: Pairs or groups of 3–5; observe individuals.
group_size.fil: Magkapareha o pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

steps.en: Ask what changes learners have heard about. Use the published lesson self-check as a mini-quiz or a locally approved UHC video if available.
steps.fil: Itanong ang narinig na pagbabago. Gamitin ang self-check ng nailathalang aralin bilang mini-quiz o aprubadong UHC video kung mayroon.

steps.en: A resident asks whether every service is free. Explain using the lesson and name what to verify locally. Swap roles and repeat after feedback.
steps.fil: Nagtatanong ang residente kung libre ang lahat. Ipaliwanag gamit ang aralin at tukuyin ang dapat tiyakin. Magpalit at ulitin matapos ang puna.

debrief.en: What changed in our initial answers?
debrief.fil: Ano ang nabago sa unang sagot?

observe.en: States the goal and concrete changes accurately and checks local arrangements.
observe.fil: Tama ang layunin at tiyak na pagbabago; tinitiyak ang lokal na kaayusan.

output.en: Plain-language explanation and a local verification question.
output.fil: Payak na paliwanag at tanong na titiyakin sa lokalidad.

alternative.en: No video needed; use discussion and the lesson.
alternative.fil: Hindi kailangan ng video; gamitin ang talakayan at aralin.
